name: Beijing InHand Networks Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing InHand Networks Technology Co., Ltd. engages in research, development, and application of industrial Internet of Things (IoT) technology. The company provides industrial Internet of Things products, enterprise network products, digital distribution network products, smart vending control system products, and other products. It also offers cloud manager, edge routers, enterprise wireless AP, 5G outdoor unit, and series enterprise switch; cellular router and portable cellular router; cellular modems; iSCADA cloud service; DeviceLive cloud, edge computers, standard edge computers, edge gateways, industrial routers, industrial ethernet switches; and power distribution overhead line monitoring system and xenergy real-time energy management solution. In addition, the company provides AI vending cooler system and smart merchandiser system, as well as vehicle gateway and inconnect remote access services. It offers IoT solutions for business networking, industrial IoT, digital energy, smart commerce, and mobility sectors. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Beijing, China.
